description:
You are a postdoctoral researcher compiling impact metrics for your tenure dossier. You need to annotate 5 specific papers in your Zotero library with their Citation Count and Research Area using the 'Extra' field.

Task Instructions:
1. Find each of the 5 papers listed below in your library.
2. For each paper, locate the 'Extra' field in the right-hand Info panel (you may need to scroll down).
3. Enter exactly two lines of text in the Extra field for each paper, following the strict format:
   Citation Count: [Number]
   Area: [Area Name]

Target Papers and Data:

1. Paper: 'Attention Is All You Need' (Vaswani et al., 2017)
   Content to add:
   Citation Count: 130000
   Area: NLP

2. Paper: 'Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition' (He et al., 2016)
   Content to add:
   Citation Count: 200000
   Area: Computer Vision

3. Paper: 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication' (Shannon, 1948)
   Content to add:
   Citation Count: 160000
   Area: Information Theory

4. Paper: 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' (Turing, 1950)
   Content to add:
   Citation Count: 25000
   Area: Artificial Intelligence

5. Paper: 'Generative Adversarial Nets' (Goodfellow et al., 2014)
   Content to add:
   Citation Count: 65000
   Area: Generative Models

Do not modify any other papers. Do not use commas in the numbers. Ensure the field names 'Citation Count:' and 'Area:' are capitalized exactly as shown.

targets.title_substring: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
